paper_role: single replacement gate for task-segmented contrastive learning; no richer-factor or generation loss

cross_fitting.group: normalized_text_sha256 globally across NR and TSR
cross_fitting.assignment: deterministic greedy balance of NR/TSR row and identity counts; seeded SHA256 tie-break

pseudo_groups.assignment: seeded alternating assignment within reading task and frozen whitespace-length stratum

arms.training_negative_mask: 31 seeded-hash-selected negatives from the other 63 common-batch examples
the other 31 common-batch examples sharing the real reading task
the other 31 common-batch examples sharing the frozen pseudo group

training.objective: symmetric cosine contrastive alignment with arm-specific frozen negative mask
training.checkpoint_rule: highest checkpoint-partition macro NR/TSR MRR; epoch zero eligible; earliest epoch breaks ties

evaluation.checkpoint_pool: same partition, dataset and task; positive plus 23 closest-length candidates with seeded SHA256 tie-break
evaluation.confirmation_pool: same partition, dataset and task; positive plus designated matched-donor text plus 22 closest-length candidates with seeded SHA256 tie-break
evaluation.primary_endpoint: seed-averaged out-of-fold per-trial reciprocal rank, macro-averaged over NR and TSR
evaluation.signal_condition: correct vector versus same-fold same-task same-subject different-text donor correct_train vector

requirements: headline macro MRR exceeds global_mixed and pseudo_task_segmented
both superiority familywise clustered lower bounds exceed zero under every cluster scheme
both headline deltas are positive in all three training seeds
all NR/TSR by baseline clustered lower bounds exceed -0.01
the absolute true-task-segmented macro-MRR clustered lower bound exceeds 0.15733159073972944
correct-minus-matched-wrong real-EEG clustered lower bounds exceed zero under every cluster scheme
the true-task-segmented signal gap is noninferior to both baselines within 0.005 MRR
continuation.failure_action: stop P4b permanently; no retuning, richer-factor training, generation training, or held-out-test access

prohibited: reuse of the consumed official-validation decision partition as confirmation
access to the held-out test split
task token or routing at inference
post-hoc change of folds, pseudo groups, margins, seeds, pools, or continuation requirements
richer-factor or generation training before every P4b requirement passes
